contexts.text: On the Hells of those who have passed their life in... cruelty. General article. AC 818. AC 819. AC 824. AC 954.
Under Adultery, see this reference, and at AC 3469:4. AC 5057. AC 5394. AC 5990. AC 7370. SE 2621. SE 2622. SE 2643. SE 2656. SE 2665. SE 2666. SE 2843. SE 3319. SE 3598. SE 3673.
When the sphere of those who have lived in cruelty, etc., is turned into odours, there is a cadaverous stench. AC 5394:end.
The life of evil Spirits... is one of the cupidities of the love of self and of the world, and is thence one of hatreds, revenges, and cruelties...
It is self-love from which spring... all cruelties. AC 2327:end. 29 10[2].

The modern Antediluvians... are cruel; they have cared only for themselves; and have accounted it nothing if the whole world were to perish for their sakes: there is a great number of such at this day... from Christendom: their Hell is the most grievous of all. AC 4327:end.
Under Jew, see this reference.
Cruelty of Sirens. AC 3663:end. AC 3688.
Under Hatred, see this reference.
Under Evil Spirit, see this reference. SE 189.
These inhabitants of Venus are delighted with rapine, but are not cruel...
Thus do revenge and cruelty become the delight of life (of those who are under the influence of selflove).
They who have contracted a fierce and cruel nature there love cadaverous things.
Fiercenesses and cruelties from the interiors appear through the forms (of the infernals).
(Predestination) is a cruel heresy. Explained. BE 65:3.
Cruelty (is one of the evils characteristic of those who are in the love of dominion from self-love).
On the extreme cruelty of some who with the mouth profess mercy and holiness.
On the cruelty of the infernal crew.

The cruelty of the infernal crew can never be described: against those upon whom they exercise their cruelties they act from phantasies in the most hostile manner... If they could exercise their cruelties according to their phantasies, their butcher's work would be more cruel than that of the most ferocious beasts: by their phantasies they as it were bring forth axes and instruments of death, and unless God Messiah were to master their savagery, those whom they strive to torment would have a most cruel sensation [of suffering]... Mankind would have exercised such cruelties if God Messiah had not saved them... SE 377. SE 391. SE 593. SE 723. SE 730. SE 749. SE 1213.
Such (luke warm Spirits) are more cruel than others.
Cruelty of the descendants of Jacob.
David's cruelty. SE 2638. SE 3346:end. SE 3657. SE 3659.
Cruelty exercised against the Lord.
This Earth has now wandered so far into cruel thoughts inwardly, while they speak well, that externals are by themselves...
Under Conscience, see this reference.
On the cruel under the buttocks.

On cruelty... There was one who was cruel (Erik Benz., junior), for he was delighted when he saw injuries and violent deaths. He was among those who are cruel, with whom I spoke. They said that they long lie as if they were half dead, until that disposition is appeased, and after they are as it were resuscitated, they have no sense, wherefore they have no noses... because they cannot have perception... Their place is in the extremity of the west, upon the lands there.
Some exercise their cruelty by means of the phantasy that they have as it were a burning candle, with which they burn others... Some kindle tow and burn them...
The cruel day of Jehovah () = the Last Judgment.

Their wine being called the poison of dragons, and the cruel gall of asps () = that the truth of the Church with the descendants of Jacob was external, containing within it infernal evils and falsities. AE 433:30. AE 519:7.
That they were not one whit in the love of truth, but in the love of falsity, is signified by that people being cruel, and having no mercy ().
